tasks.title: Step 1 · Open Connect (#/connect), start the Agent Browser (port 9222), and sign into your 12 dropshipping tools
tasks.nextAction: Click Connect in the top-left sidebar, press Start Agent Browser, sign into Kalodata, TikTok, Amazon, CJdropshipping, Meta Ads Manager & Shopify Admin, then run os.mjs connect check.
tasks.notes: Once connected, the sidebar badge turns green and agents can work directly inside your authenticated tabs.

tasks.title: Step 2 · Configure your Store Brand & Shopify/Meta credentials in USER.md and hydrogen-storefront/.env
tasks.nextAction: Copy hydrogen-storefront/.env.example to .env, add your Shopify Storefront/Admin API tokens & Meta Pixel ID, and update USER.md with your store name and budget rules.
tasks.notes: Launchroom runs at http://localhost:3000/p/merrivy/ and the live Hydrogen storefront preview runs at http://localhost:3021.

tasks.title: Step 3 · Run Step 1 · Product (#/find) using the 200-Keyword Kalodata Bible to scrape & filter winning candidates
tasks.nextAction: Ask your agent in chat: "Run a Kalodata US product discovery round from the Keyword Bible and save passing candidates to #/find."
tasks.notes: Enforces F1-F6: 2+ dated revenue points, dropshippable physical product, 3+ avatars, and downloaded #1-#3 viral .mp4 videos + .jpg thumbnails.

tasks.title: Step 4 · Run Step 2 · Verify (#/verify) & approve your first Winner on #/winners
tasks.nextAction: Have checker run the 5-Gate Hard Verification Funnel (Two-Layer Meta Competitor check, 4-Way Pricing <35% landed cost, CJ supplier link + saved photo), then click Approve & Build Store on #/winners.
tasks.notes: 90% of scraped products get filtered out here so only pre-validated winners reach your eye test.

tasks.title: Step 5 · Build your Storefront on #/build (clone base-theme.json, 2-Kit pricing + $4.99 Shipping Protection)
tasks.nextAction: Clone base-theme.json in #/build, populate the 5-section Grimoire copy and store gallery, set 1-Kit vs 2-Kit (SAVE 15% + Free Shipping), and send the supplier photo for a fulfillment quote.
tasks.notes: Review the live 375px mobile preview on the right side of #/build as you edit.

tasks.title: Step 6 · Generate your Ad Pack on #/create (#1 Kalodata video + 20 4:5 Static Ads + 5x5 Copy Pack)
tasks.nextAction: Prep the #1 top-revenue viral video (9:16) and generate 20 4:5 static ads (10 Problem-Aware + 10 Solution-Aware) using the 50 reference layouts in agents/image-generator/references/.
tasks.notes: Approve your final creatives and 5 evergreen captions + 5 headlines on #/create.

tasks.title: Step 7 · Complete the 7/7 Pre-Launch Checklist (#/checklist), launch your $50/day CBO (#/launch), and monitor #/manage
tasks.nextAction: Verify all 7 pre-launch checks on #/checklist, set your $50/day CBO budget and $50 first-test loss limit on #/launch, and track 15-minute live Meta + Shopify sync in #/manage.
tasks.notes: Hold the 4-Day Meta Algorithm Priming window and follow the End-of-Day 3 Kill / Day 4+ Scale rules.
